description: Small-scale photovoltaic system power and operating conditions data from OptimalPV project is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Kari Lappalainen (Tampere University). This dataset contains measurement data of power production and operating conditions of small-scale photovoltaic systems used in the OptimalPV project funded by the Research Council of Finland (funding decision 348701). The data is from the Tampere University Photovoltaic Power Research Plant located in Tampere, Finland. Coverage: national (FI); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
